title: RetroBedrockTotem
description: Restores balance in cross-play PvP matches. Enables Bedrock Edition Geyser players to pop totems straight from inventory, mitigating physical touch-control lag.
body:
# RetroBedrockTotem **A lightweight plugin that gives your Bedrock (Floodgate) players a custom PvP buff!**
**RetroBedrockTotem** is a simple, plug-and-play plugin that gives your Bedrock (Floodgate) players a special advantage, perfect for PvP, anarchy, or any fast-paced server. Normally, totems only work from your hands. This plugin changes the rules **for Bedrock players only**, allowing their totems to activate from **anywhere in their inventory**! --- ## ✨ Features * **Activates Totems From Anywhere:** Scans the entire inventory for a Totem of Undying on fatal damage. * **Bedrock (Floodgate) Only:** This buff applies *only* to players connected via Floodgate. Your Java players keep vanilla mechanics. * **Lightweight & Efficient:** Optimized to add zero lag to combat. It only runs checks on a fatal blow. * **Vanilla-Friendly Effects:** Plays all the standard totem sounds, particles, and applies the correct Regeneration/Absorption effects. * **Zero Config:** Just drag, drop, and play. No setup needed! --- ## 📦 Requirements This plugin **requires** two things to function: 1. **A Spigot/Paper/Folia Server:** Works on Spigot and any of its forks (Paper, Pufferfish, Purpur, Folia, etc.). 2. **[Floodgate](https://modrinth.com/plugin/floodgate):** This is essential for detecting Bedrock players. The plugin will not work without it. --- ## 💾 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` file from the "Versions" tab. 2. Drop the `RetroBedrockTotem.jar` into your server's `/plugins` folder. 3. Restart your server. There are no configs, commands, or permissions. It just works! --- ### 💬 Support & Source Code Got an idea or found a bug? Please create an issue on the [**Official GitHub Repository**](https://github.com/AJARETRO/RetroBedrockTotem)!
